reason: Both are branch/operating-company based contractors that install and service building systems for commercial, industrial and institutional owners, earning money from project and recurring service work. They overlap on HVAC installation and maintenance and some life-safety work. APi's core is fire protection, security, elevator and infrastructure/utility services. Comfort Systems' core is mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting plus prefabrication. Overlap is partial, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
